title: Stage-2 QM9-mu TRUE-DFT cell: 7-arm geometry/architecture decomposition + matched RF ceiling + gate-fix mechanism-completeness probe
question: Does feeding Uni-Mol TRUE GDB-9 DFT coordinates (vs MMFF) make frozen 3D-pair injection beat the descriptor RF on the geometry-pure QM9 dipole? And, once the co-update gate-LR wiring is fixed so the richest mechanism actually trains, does a geometry signal appear?

provenance.note: All numbers are the literal 'Best Test RMSE' lines from the HPC logs (not estimates). Raw logs pulled to paper/audits/stage2_dft_logs/ when VPN is up (VPN was down at archive time 2026-06-03).
provenance.gatefix_probe_job: 138942 (hpc/_t8_gate_probe.sh; T8 + T8random with the gate-LR fix on MMFF QM9-mu), logs hpc/logs/qm9mu_T8{,random}_gatefix.log

protocol.deep: finetune, 1000 pretrain + ft_max_epochs 40 / patience 15, batch 1024, K 10, hid_dim 512, eval_seeds 9/19/29, RMSE on test split
protocol.coords: TRUE GDB-9 DFT (B3LYP/6-31G(2df,p)) from molnet gdb9.sdf, NOT RDKit-MMFF
protocol.alignment: Solution B: graph kept IDENTICAL to MMFF cell (from SMILES, canonical order); only the coords Uni-Mol sees change, transferred onto canonical AddHs order by generic-bond GetSubstructMatch + per-molecule physical bond-length gate (0/275354 nonphysical bonds on the retained set)

two_stage_filtering.stage1_lookup_coverage: 14833/15000 = 98.89% have a gdb9 DFT mol (167 dropped = gdb9 RDKit-unsanitizable); reported in data/qm9/qm9_dft_alignment_report.json
two_stage_filtering.stage2_reorder_pass: 12530/14833 = 84.5% pass the canonical-order coord transfer + bond gate; ~16% dropped where the published gdb9-SDF connectivity disagrees with the SMILES (genuine QM9 data ambiguity, conservatively dropped); reported in data/qm9/qm9_dft_reorder_report.json
two_stage_filtering.NOTE: the '98.9%' and '16% dropped' are DIFFERENT stages, not a contradiction; the deep+RF cell both run on the SAME 12532/1256-test subset (matched)

protocol.rf: qm9mu_rf_matched.py on unimol_out_qm9mu_dft (the IDENTICAL DFT subset, embed_ok only); Morgan(1024)+descriptors; RandomForestRegressor(300) seeds 9/19/29; weak11=composition desc, strongFull=full RDKit incl Gasteiger charges; geometry-blind so the comparison vs deep is on the SAME molecules

geometry_effect._def: real - matched_random (negative = real DFT geometry helps beyond architecture)

dft_cell.verdict: 3D injection inert even with TRUE DFT geometry. V2T5/T7 read no geometry (+0.0003 / +0.0174); T8 shows a small SHRINKING effect (-0.0098 vs MMFF -0.0327). Best real deep arm V0 0.8798 is BEATEN by charge-aware RF 0.8446 on the IDENTICAL subset (by 0.035). The descriptor ceiling holds on the geometry-pure dipole with real DFT coords. NOTE: absolute RMSE (~0.88) is lower than the MMFF pilot (~0.99) purely because of the easier 12.5k subset (V0 is geometry-free yet dropped identically) -- so MMFF-vs-DFT absolute values are NOT comparable; deep-vs-RF ON THE SAME SUBSET is the valid gate.

gatefix_probe.purpose: close the 'T8 gates never trained' loophole: the --finetune high-LR gate group originally matched only attn_gate (T7), missing T8 node/pair/ffn_gate; fixed to GATE_SUFFIXES=(attn_gate,node_gate,pair_gate,ffn_gate). Re-run T8 + T8random on MMFF QM9-mu.
gatefix_probe.gates_moved: YES: layer pair_gate reaches ~+0.30/-0.37, node_gate ~+/-0.08, ffn_gate ~+/-0.15 across the 4 layers (from init 0); the channel is now active
gatefix_probe.verdict: DECISIVE: gates MOVE but the co-update gets WORSE (0.9889 vs buggy 0.9664) and the apparent geometry effect COLLAPSES (-0.0327 -> -0.0029). Per the pre-registered rule (gates move AND error improves => suppressed signal; gates move WITHOUT improvement => data-bound), the negative is DATA-BOUND, not a design/wiring artifact. The small MMFF 'effect' was a frozen-gate edge-weight side path, not the co-update mechanism.

decision_gate.gate_a_detail: best real deep DFT arm V0 0.8798 > strong charge-RF 0.8446 on the identical subset -> RF still beats deep by 0.035.
decision_gate.gate_b_detail: DFT T8 geometry effect -0.0098 SHRANK vs MMFF -0.0327; gate-fix probe: gates move but T8 worse + geometry collapses -> no suppressed signal.
decision_gate.branch: NEGATIVE (Branch B/C): frozen 3D-pair injection is inert even on the geometry-pure dipole with true DFT coords and the richest properly-trained mechanism; the descriptor/RF ceiling holds across the whole geometry-signal spectrum (ADMET -> QM7 -> QM9-mu MMFF -> QM9-mu DFT).
decision_gate.venue_implication: AAAI-positive (3D genuinely helps) is dead. This is a clean, mechanism-complete NEGATIVE/boundary result; venue = ICDE-EAB / TMLR / NeurIPS D&B audit paper.

caveats: n=3 seeds (single fixed split); below the team's own n=9 retraction bar -- report with a power-bound statement, not as a strong claim.
subset confound on ABSOLUTE values: the 12.5k DFT subset is easier than the 14.8k MMFF set (V0 0.99->0.88); only the deep-vs-RF comparison ON THE SAME SUBSET is valid, NOT DFT-vs-MMFF absolute RMSE.
the 3D 'instrument' is a non-equivariant spectral backbone reading geometry via a coordinate-free pair/edge-weight path; generality to equivariant encoders (DimeNet/EGNN) is untested.
